title: What-if baseline file (schema version 1)
description: baselines/<baseline-id>.json. An illustrative official household expenditure baseline for the What-if basket. The monthly amounts are the yearly source amounts divided by 12 and rounded as the rounding field says. The app never scales a baseline by household size.

baselineId.description: Names the household type and the classification revision, for example household.single.r2025. A new revision changes the ID, so the pipeline never splices across revisions.

version.description: The data year. A new year under the same revision changes the version and keeps the ID.

householdType.description: Which households the baseline describes. A profile of one person selects single, and two or more people select two_or_more.

monthlyYen.description: Yen per household per month, already rounded, and above zero. A category the baseline lacks is absent, never zero, so the app disables its slider.

rounding.description: nearest_yen rounds to the nearest yen and rounds an exact half up (away from zero for a positive amount), so the pipeline and the app produce the same figure.
